about.title: Concept first, then aesthetics.
about.p1: I'm Mahmoud Ayman, known as Timo. A creative graphic designer with two years of experience. My work starts with the idea, not just the look. I create fresh concepts and shape them visually in a clear, simple way, so the feeling reaches the client fast, with no long explanations. I care about details, and I believe a great design is one you understand at first glance and remember afterwards.
